_meta.description: Panel parameter registry for Radia-NGSolve. Source of truth for LLM <-> panel mapping.
_meta.ja_description: Radia-NGSolve パネル定義。自然言語 <-> CLI パラメータの双方向変換に使用。

inductance.ja_description: コイル STEP -> L_coil (vacuum) または L_coil + ΔL (weak-coupled).  --coil-solver peec | bem-a で切替。--vol 指定で workpiece 弱結合 (Telegen φ・B back-reaction)。
inductance.method: PEEC perimeter filaments OR BEM-A Weggler EFIE saddle (RWG); workpiece scalar BIE + SIBC Robin

params.name: coil_step
params.help: Coil CAD STEP file (required for --coil-solver peec)

params.name: coil_vol
params.help: Coil pre-meshed surface .vol (required for --coil-solver bem-a; must contain 'source'/'sink' boundary labels)

params.name: coil_solver
params.help: peec: PEEC perimeter filaments from STEP (fast). bem-a: Weggler EFIE on RWG, reads pre-meshed .vol.

params.name: peec_proximity
params.help: Use proximity-aware iterative PEEC (default ON; augments the Bessel self-skin Zs_fil with the Leontovich surface dissipation evaluated from the actual Biot-Savart H field at each filament's wire-surface position).  Pass --no-peec-proximity to fall back to the isolated-wire Bessel self-skin only.

params.name: peec_proximity_max_iter
params.help: Maximum proximity outer iterations.  On the 3-turn pancake at 150 kHz the iteration exhibits a transient hump near iter 30 then settles by iter 50 (relax=0.3).  Default 60 gives ~10 iter margin.

params.name: peec_proximity_relax
params.help: Proximity outer-iteration under-relaxation factor (0 < relax <= 1; 0.3 is conservative).

params.name: coil_maxh
params.help: DEPRECATED (kept for back-compat); BEM-A now reads pre-meshed --coil-vol instead of re-meshing CAD on-the-fly.

params.name: coil_source_name
params.help: Coil source-cap face name (bem-a; falls back to area-based detection if absent)

params.name: coil_sink_name
params.help: Coil sink-cap face name (bem-a; same fallback)

params.name: coil_aca_eps
params.help: HACApK ACA eps for coil (bem-a, future)

params.name: coil_gmres_tol
params.help: HACApK GMRES tol for coil (bem-a, future)

params.name: coil_saddle_solver
params.help: Saddle-point solver for BEM-A: auto (LU < 10000 tris, MINRES above), lu (dense LAPACK, overwrite_a=True), minres (Krylov symmetric indefinite), gmres (generic Krylov). Defaults to auto.

params.name: coil_sigma
params.physics: コイル抵抗計算用 [S/m]

params.name: vol
params.help: Workpiece .vol file (omit for vacuum L only)
params.physics: Netgen Vol 形式。材料・境界ラベル・高次要素を含む

params.name: sigma
params.physics: 材料の電気伝導率。銅: 5.8e7, 鉄: 2e6 [S/m]

params.name: mu_r
params.physics: mu = mu_0 * mu_r

params.name: half_thickness
params.physics: ESIM 厚さ [m]

params.name: bh_file
params.physics: 2列: H[A/m] B[T]

params.name: impedance_model
params.help: sibc: linear Dowell tanh formula. esim: nonlinear Karl iteration; requires --bh-file.
params.ja: インピーダンスモデル
params.physics: esim/dowell/sibc

params.name: esim_relax
params.help: Karl under-relaxation (0,1]; 1.0 = full step, 0.5 = half-step (default, matches calc_fem_kelvin).  Lower if Karl oscillates near saturation.

params.name: esim_per_panel
params.help: Per-DOF ESIM Karl iteration (Phase B): the ESIM cell solver is called once per BEM DOF using a per-node H_t extracted from the phi_vec, building a per-node Z_s ndarray instead of a single scalar.  Resolves the spatial saturation pattern; costs N_DOF extra ESIM calls per Karl iter (~5 ms each).  Requires --wp-bem-backend intree-dense.

params.name: esim_anderson_m
params.help: Anderson-acceleration memory depth for the outer Karl iteration.  0 (default) = plain damped Picard.  3-5 closes the per-DOF dZ_max noise floor when --esim-per-panel is used.  See src/radia/esim_anderson.py.

params.name: h1_order
params.help: Workpiece BEM Lagrange basis order (NOT the geometry curving order, which is auto-detected from the .vol's companion .vol.json -- the .vol's curvedelements is fixed at Cubit-export time and a post-load mesh.Curve(p) silently falls back to flat). 1 = P1 hat (flat-friendly default).  2 = Lagrange-P2 (uses curved Tri6 geometry if the .vol has curve order >= 2, otherwise P2 basis on flat Tri3 geometry).

params.name: frequency
params.physics: 渦電流の浸透深さ delta = sqrt(2*rho/(omega*mu)) を決める

params.name: current
params.physics: ソース電流 [A]。J = I / A_cross で電流密度に変換

params.name: msh_output
params.physics: 場の可視化用 .msh v4.1

params.name: coil_msh_output
params.help: Coil .msh viz output path. PEEC: writes <this>=B-on-bbox + <stem>_filaments.msh (1D polylines + |I|).  open_gmsh.py auto-merges the filament sibling.
